title: Surreal Cosmic Eye Chamber
description: A surreal painted scene depicts a woman with long pink hair in a traditional pink hanbok standing beside a massive cracked eye mural on a purple wall. The eye contains a red iris with two green serpents and a black clock hand, while the floor is a swirling cosmic nebula with a black silhouette of a curly-haired woman floating above it holding a glowing orb. An ornate archway on the right reveals a colorful abstract cosmic explosion.
prompt: Surreal fantasy room interior with a woman in a pink traditional Korean hanbok standing on the left, a giant cracked human eye painted on the purple wall featuring a red iris with two intertwined green snakes and a black clock hand piercing through it, cosmic galaxy nebula floor with stars and planets, a black silhouette of a woman with curly hair floating on the floor holding a glowing blue orb, ornate golden archway on the right opening into a vibrant multicolored cosmic explosion of paint, mystical and dreamlike atmosphere
